title: カメラを構える
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE original square pose preview for an art studio website. Create one finished detailed gouache/anime illustration of ONE clothed young adult with medium tousled brown hair, natural facial features, cream long sleeve shirt with rolled cuffs, loose indigo trousers, pale sneakers. Plain pale ivory studio backdrop with soft warm natural shading. Natural face, fingers, joints, dimensional clothing folds, broad gender neutral styling. Whole body including both feet completely visible, character and necessary prop large about 80%canvas, clear action readable as small UI thumbnail. Single distinct image, NOT stick figure, NOT schematic, NOT flat icon, NOT contact sheet. No text, labels, diagram arrows, logos, grid, border, fancy costumes, brands or watermark. Action: Standing taking a photograph with ONE black camera. Right hand grips camera side and index finger rests on shutter, LEFT PALM supports lens FROM BELOW. Both elbows bent; camera held near face, eye directed to viewfinder. Exactly two hands connected to two wrists, natural fingers touch intended camera surfaces. Both feet grounded in comfortable stance.

visualQA.reviewer: Codex visual inspection of generated image
visualQA.observations: 右手がカメラのグリップ・シャッター側、左手がレンズ下を支え、二つの腕と手が区別できる。

label: カメラを構える
encoding: RGB JPEG quality 85; generated resolution retained without cropping or retouching
